correctness.rationale: For all m≥3, all positive concentrations, distinct categories and integer r≥1, Dirichlet integration yields three joint/marginal probabilities, hence Q_n. Its adjacent ratio is 1−a(b+r)/[(T−b+n−r)(T−a+n)]<1. Q_r>1; strict log-Gamma convexity gives Q_infty<1. A trigamma-integral comparison establishes a unique real zero. The symmetric expansion follows by reciprocal telescoping with controlled O(m^-3) log error; alpha=1 is an exact telescoping identity. The standalone exact verifier checked 29,784 assertions, including independent composition enumeration and high-precision tests. Finite tests supplement but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A motivated structural dependence boundary for zeros and low-frequency observations in overdispersed categorical samples: a unique sign transition holds for all unequal positive concentrations and all fixed positive r. The universal leading threshold n∼rm and a concentration-sensitive second-order correction distinguish reinforcement from the basic occupancy scale. The exact alpha=1 crossing is a natural complete specialization; this is more than computing a finite table or restating a covariance of raw counts.
